technique_name: Help this student plan an effective study schedule.
description: An effective study schedule should include a balance of academic work, relaxation and social activities. Start by making a list of all the classes and assignments that need to be completed. Then, break these down into manageable tasks that will be completed each day or week. It's important to set realistic and achievable goals. Schedule adequate time to complete the tasks, and make sure to leave some time for relaxation and social activities.
